name: alpha-hit-corpse-base
note: alpha-white (QA 13b #21/#29): sustained machine-gun fire on an Alpha until it drops, then the body lies. The figure must keep its own look the whole time: a hit flashes it briefly (no grey-white mass), the downed body and corpse keep the live colours (bloodied is fine). `look` gates the crowd pixels at every sheet frame: pale unsaturated share and hue drift against frame 0.
